cars_has_model.name: cars_has_model
cars_has_model.value: "cars"."model_id" is not null or "cars"."custom_model_text" is not null

media_purpose_fits_owner.name: media_purpose_fits_owner
media_purpose_fits_owner.value:
("media"."purpose" in ('reception_side', 'reception_defect') and "media"."reception_act_id" is not null)
        or ("media"."purpose" in ('task_before', 'task_after') and "media"."task_id" is not null and "media"."attempt" is not null)
        or ("media"."purpose"::text = 'product_photo' and "media"."product_id" is not null)
        or ("media"."purpose"::text = 'stock_invoice' and "media"."stock_document_id" is not null)

reception_acts_sent_is_complete.name: reception_acts_sent_is_complete
reception_acts_sent_is_complete.value: "reception_acts"."status" = 'draft' or ("reception_acts"."mileage_km" is not null and "reception_acts"."fuel_level" is not null and "reception_acts"."sent_at" is not null)

reception_acts_confirmed_is_signed.name: reception_acts_confirmed_is_signed
reception_acts_confirmed_is_signed.value: "reception_acts"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("reception_acts"."confirmed_at" is not null and "reception_acts"."confirmed_via" is not null)

reception_acts_verbal_has_witness.name: reception_acts_verbal_has_witness
reception_acts_verbal_has_witness.value: "reception_acts"."confirmed_via" is distinct from 'verbal' or "reception_acts"."confirmed_by" is not null

products_for_sale_priced_in_pieces.name: products_for_sale_priced_in_pieces
products_for_sale_priced_in_pieces.value: not "products"."is_for_sale" or ("products"."unit" = 'pcs' and "products"."sell_price" is not null)

stock_documents_posted_fields.name: stock_documents_posted_fields
stock_documents_posted_fields.value: ("stock_documents"."status" = 'posted') = ("stock_documents"."posted_at" is not null and "stock_documents"."posted_by" is not null)

stock_documents_supplier_only_on_receipt.name: stock_documents_supplier_only_on_receipts
stock_documents_supplier_only_on_receipt.value: "stock_documents"."kind" = 'receipt' or ("stock_documents"."supplier_id" is null and "stock_documents"."invoice_no" is null)
